page.layout: One printed page, left part only: running title/heading across the top at full width; a woodcut illustration of a fish filling the page; a caption line in running text below the illustration at full width.; One page of text, with a large woodcut of a fish filling the page; running head at top right of the text area, page number at top right; a caption line below the illustration, set in running text across the lower part of the page.

main_text.head: De Cartilaginibus
main_text.p: TORPEDINIS cuiusdam figura à pictore Vene-
eto depicta, nulli illarum, quas Rondeletius

page.notes: Woodcut illustration of a fish (a torpedo ray) occupies the page; no text inside it. The title at the top is partly cut off at the right edge. The caption begins with a large woodcut initial T and runs on past the cut edge: "Tpingit, similis; nec satis probè, ut suspicor, expressit." The caption's first line is printed as "TORPEDINIS cuiusdam figura à pictore Vene-" and its second line "pingit, similis; nec satis probè, ut suspicor, expressi" is cut off at the right edge. The page is mostly a woodcut of a fish with no printed text beside it. The running head is cut at its left edge in the scan; the reading "is planis." is partial. The caption line is cut at its left edge, so the start of the line is not visible. The signature "L 4" is printed beneath the caption.
